tagline: A walk-around demo: a school building with corridors of lockers, a gym, a lobby with a trophy, a cafeteria and a bus out front.
overview:
The School Demo is one of RedEngine's example scenes: a full school to wander around rather than a game to win. A low school building stands in fenced grounds with a yellow school bus out front. Inside are a lobby with a trophy on a plinth, corridors lined with coloured lockers, a gym with a basketball court and stands, and a cafeteria with long tables.

You walk around in first person (Q switches to third person) carrying the default baseball bat. There are no goals or scores; it exists to show what the engine's building tools and furniture catalogue can make, and makes a good map for hide and seek with friends.
story: No story: an empty school on a quiet day, after the last bell, with the bus still parked out front. It was built as a showcase of RedEngine's buildings and furniture, from lockers and benches to the gym's court.
goal: There is no goal and no way to win or lose: explore.
rules: Walk anywhere in the school and its grounds.
Your bat can knock loose objects around.
Nothing is scored and there is no time limit.
